City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation to Sheriff's Deputy William Dunford
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of-way located at East I Street, adjacent to 956 Cornish Drive. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-52 approving the summary vacation of a portion of East I Street right-of-way fronting the property at 956 Cornish Drive.
2014-08-27 Item 8A - Vacation for 956 Cornish, E. I Street
8B.
Acceptance and filing of the Notice of Completion of the Second Street, C Street, and Third Street Sewer Improvements, CE08B. Contact Person: Deputy City Engineer Shields
1) Accept the public improvements; and 2) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2014-08-27 Item 8B - Sewer Improvements CE08B
8C.
Annual Investment Report and Annual Adoption of Investment Policy. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
1) Accept and file the Annual Investment Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2014; and 2) Adopt the Investment Policy to be effective for the fiscal year 2014-15.
2014-08-27 Item 8C - Annual Investment Report and Annual Adoption of Investment Policy
8D.
Award of contract for HVAC replacement at Encinitas Community and Senior Center. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent Frenken
Award contract for HVAC replacement at Encinitas Community and Senior Center to Jackson and Blanc in the amount of $443,800. Allocate a portion of funding in the amount of $50,049 from parking lot improvements (Fund 101-CP04G) from the FY 2014-15 CIP budget.
2014-08-27 Item 8D - HVAC Replacement Contract
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
This Agenda Item has been continued to October 8, 2014. It only appears on the Agenda because it has been noticed.
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning and Building Department's approval of an Affordable Unit Policy application to legalize an established dwelling unit created as a result of an unpermitted garage conversion. The project site is located in Residential 5 (R-5) zone and the coastal Zone. CASE NUMBER: 13-218 ADU; APPLICANT: James Kessler; APPELLANTS: Daniel R. Lowe and Dana Hu-Lowe; LOCATION: 934 Arden Drive (APN: 258-232-24). Contact Person: Senior Planner Sapa'u
This Agenda Item has been continued to October 8, 2014. It only appears on the Agenda because it has been noticed.
10B.
Receive the appraisal for former Fire Station 2 parcel at 1867 Mackinnon Road and provide staff direction. Receive the cost estimate for an appraisal of the City-owned 10-acre parcel on Quail Gardens Drive at 634 Quail Gardens Lane and provide staff direction.
2014-08-27 Item 10B - Fire Station 2 Appraisal
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
An overview of the Coastal Development Permit requirements for new residential homes, additions and remodels. Contact Person: Senior Planner Kusiak
Receive report and provide direction to staff, as appropriate.
2014-08-27 Item 11A - Coastal Development Permit Requirements

12A.

2014-08-27 Item 12A - Council Member Initiated Item

16.

17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
